description: Test suite for the Product Configurator in ERPNext, testing item creation, product listing, and product visibility across item groups.

classes.name: TestProductConfigurator
classes.description: Unit test class for product configurator functionalities, including item creation, product listing, and multi-group visibility.

methods.name: setUpClass
methods.description: Initial setup for the test class, creating a variant item.

methods.name: create_variant_item
methods.description: Creates a variant item '_Test Variant Item - 2XL' if it does not exist.

methods.name: create_regular_web_item
methods.description: Creates a regular web item with specified name and item group if it does not exist.

methods.name: test_product_list
methods.description: Tests the product listing page for correct number of items based on database entries and filters.

methods.name: test_get_products_for_website
methods.description: Tests retrieval of products for website filtering by attributes.

methods.name: test_products_in_multiple_item_groups
methods.description: Checks if a product is visible across multiple item group pages, including its own and foreign groups.
